name: Calm Forest
description: The woodlands that make up the bulk of the environment. Contains all of the resources you need to take the next step towards progress, but also is home to hostile Jakyls.

name: Pine Woods
description: Visibility is the biggest concern in this biome, as it is filled with heavy fog, dense forestry, and constant elevation changes. You’ll find no shortage of trees to chop here. While navigation can be difficult, it provides plenty of opportunities to escape the hostile Jakyls and Terratoads.

name: Snowy Peaks
description: Cold mountaintops which require a source of warmth to survive comfortably. The Yagi deer make their home on the mountainside, which are often found licking the high tier minerals in the area.

name: Breezy Grasslands
description: Many animals can be found grazing among the rolling hills and windswept trees. Petals of the nearby flowers can be found drifting in the wind.

name: Autumn Forest
description: The red leaves of the maple trees create an atmosphere of fall year round. The Scrofa forage through the many fiber bushes in search of mushrooms.

name: Misty Tundra
description: Large fields of flowers populate this otherwise rocky terrain. The far edges are home to massive cliffsides and waterfalls. The soldier wasps pollinate the flowers, and the Umbura roam catching the fish from the rivers.

name: Desert Wasteland
description: Harsh heat makes survival in this area difficult without a source of cooling. Many crustaceans burrow to avoid the intensity of the sun, and you may find yourself surrounded by a swarm if not careful. Despite the brutal conditions, this biome is home to the Baobab trees, granting a near infinite amount of higher tier wood.

name: Swamp
description: An area difficult to navigate reliably due to the swamp water scattered throughout. A perfect environment for the Cypress trees and Pink Lilies to thrive

name: Rocky Garden
description: Frequent elevation changes make traversal of these stone filled lands a nightmare for all but the drones and skitches which make this place their home. Large scale construction efforts will be needed to allow transport of goods by wagon through the area.

name: Open Ocean
description: Vast open waters containing large fish of all varieties and plenty of seaweed. While sailing, keep an eye out for any lost cargo or shipments floating in the water.

name: Safe Meadows
description: A calm place devoid of hostile wildlife, this area has all the resources you would need to find your footing. Home to the remnants of an ancient civilization, these places have become a first home for those getting their start in the world.

name: Cave
description: The underground is home to large amounts of untapped ore to be mined.

name: Jungle
description: The humid weather allows for lush vegetation of all varieties among the cliffs and rivers found here. The toads and drones can frequently be stumbled upon while sifting through the jute and bamboo that cover the jungle floor.

name: Sapwoods
description: A mysterious forest surrounded by cliffsides. The large sapwood trees are valued for their high tier wood. Many of the strongest Umbura make their home here, feasting on the honey produced by the queens. It’s best to come here prepared to defend yourself.

name: Uncharted Ocean
description: Open water beyond the mapped routes.
